acceptanceCriteria: The next numbered preregistration of benchmarks/daily-loop-v0 and of benchmarks/untouched-repository-v1 each carries V1-0742's bounded agent_cost reader with a named invalid-observations class.
Each old seal is superseded by a numbered amendment row and never rewritten in place.
body: Decision 0430 item 2 (beamfall/corvint#581, owner acceptance relayed by the claude-mem session, 2026-10-04). V1-0742 (PR #543) bounded only daily-loop-v1, because benchmarks/daily-loop-v0/harness.py (digest 4a27e8ef…) and benchmarks/untouched-repository-v1/harness.py (digest b67cc95a…) are sealed by committed preregistrations, including the held-out cobra one and a private beamfall/core one. The owner accepted applying the reader only as a new numbered preregistration amendment at each harness's next reseal; no seal may be edited in place. V1-0369 still owns daily-loop-v0's savings semantics; V1-0382 owns other daily-loop-v0 harness fixes.
title: Apply V1-0742's bounded agent_cost reader to daily-loop-v0 and untouched-repository-v1 at their next numbered preregistration
